title: Midnight Local
description: Last local, andheri tunnel, aur ek raaz. Teen-safe mystery thriller.
userRole: First-year college student, late-night local traveller
setting: Mumbai suburban railway, 11:47 PM, monsoon season
tone: Suspenseful but warm; spooky-fun, never traumatizing. Humour via banter.
safetyNotes: The 'ghost' must turn out to be a human misunderstanding.
Theft is resolved through cleverness, never violence.
